text:
Maya: :rotating_light: alert from autoscaler: us-east4 ephemeral-gpu pool failing to provision, queue growing X2 in 5m
Ravi: seeing same in dashboards, queue depth at 12k, p95 latency for gen requests spiking to 6s
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026738 - autoscale-provision-fail (pager routed to SRE)
Maya: customer impact: a few mid-size customers reporting timeouts on synchronous inference routes; embeddings backlog increasing
Jordan: logs show GCP quota denied responses when creating GPUs. snippet: `ERROR: quotaExceeded: requested 'nvidia-tesla' exceeds allowed`
Sam: which quota? GPU per region or project-level?
Ravi: looks like project GPU quota depleted in us-east4. Attempts to fall back to warm pool hit limit too.
Elena: tagging support to prepare customer comms if we can't recover in 30m @support-team :warning:
Maya: oncall plan: 1) throttle non-critical batch jobs, 2) reroute new requests to us-central1 if compatible, 3) request quota increase with GCP console, 4) enable manual fallback to smaller model variant for time-sensitive customers
Jordan: I can push a temporary routing rule. Adding patch now: `route-policy: prefer-region(us-central1) if queue>1000`
Sam: executed. Confirmed some traffic started to shift, but compatibility check shows 12% of requests require region-local model due to pinned versions
Ravi: running quick list of pinned customers: `customers_pinned = ["acme","capsule"]` - pinging SEs to allow fallback models
Maya: Seeding throttles: lowering background batch concurrency by 70% via: `kubectl scale job batch-workloads --replicas=2 -n inference`
oncall-bot: Action taken: scaled batch-workloads -> 2 replicas (Maya)
Elena: Support: please add affected customers to the status page with note "degraded inference performance in us-east4"
Sam: I opened a quota request with GCP (case 987654321). ETA on auto-approve is unknown, but requested emergency escalation.
Jordan: If quota increase delayed, propose draining ephemeral pool and spinning up preemptible GPUs in us-central1 to handle spike. Preemptible config ready (image: rwd-infer:preempt-v2).
Ravi: preemptible boot failures noted earlier; we should limit to spot if fallback is risky. Any objections?
Maya: go ahead with preemptible in us-central1 but route only non-pinned traffic there first.
Sam: launching 8 preemptible instances now: `infractl launch --region us-central1 --type a2-highgpu-1 --count 8 --preemptible`
ops-bot: infractl: job 32145 queued -> creating instances
Jordan: rollback plan: if preemptible churn >20%, we will reduce routing immediately and re-enable queue backpressure
Ravi: monitoring shows queue reduced by ~30% since routing change and throttle. Latency p95 down to 3.2s (was 6s)
Maya: good. ETA for quota approval? Sam?
Sam: GCP replied: "escalation received, investigating" - no firm ETA. I've flagged for Priority support.
Elena: OK prepping draft for status page / customers: short, factual, time + regions impacted, mitigation steps, and expected next update at +30m
Maya: can we unblock any pinned customers? Jordan, can we temporarily unpin model for acme?
Jordan: spoke to acme SE, they accept smaller variant for 15% quality drop for the next hour. Unpinned via feature flag `pin_model=false` for that tenant.
Ravi: logs: several allocation attempts returned `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED` from GCP API. attaching small trace: ```
2026-03-15T14:02:11Z alloc: request -> us-east4
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z gcp: ERROR quotaExceeded GPUs
2026-03-15T14:02:12Z autoscaler: fallback->warmpool failed
```
Maya: oncall handoff incoming in 12m. @Ravi please prepare a one-line summary for next oncall: root cause = region GPU quota exhausted causing autoscaler unable to provision ephemeral pool; mitigations = throttled batch jobs, routed to us-central1 (preemptible), unpinned key customers, quota escalation with GCP.
Ravi: summary ready. Also note: long-term mitigation item: increase regional reserved capacity or enable cross-region warm pool spillover (RFC required).
Sam: infractl reports 6/8 preemptible instances active. Traffic now balancing.
Elena: support posted initial status: "Investigating degraded inference in us-east4; partial reroutes to us-central1 in progress." :thumbsup:
oncall-bot: Reminder: pager rotation handoff in 10m to Maya->Jordan
Maya: handing off to Jordan. Jordan, take lead; I'll stay in thread for escalation with partnerships (quota)
Jordan: taking over. Running checklist: confirm pinned list, confirm preemptible stability, keep throttles until queue < 1000.
Ravi: queue now at 980. p95 latency 2.8s.
Jordan: update: preemptible pool stable at 7/8. Still watch for preemptions. If preemption rate crosses 25% we'll spin more and shift noncritical work to cold storage.
Sam: GCP just updated: "Quota increase under review; expect decision within 4 hours" - will keep escalating.
Maya: next update at +20m unless situation changes. Thanks all for quick coordination. :heart:
Elena: filing post-incident action: `PIA-2026-03-15-01` to track quota policy, reserved capacity, and automated cross-region failover runbooks.
Jordan: closing incident if stable after 30m, else escalate to SEV-1.
Elena: noted.
